word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Web of Trust

conceptHeader.description: A Web of Trust (WoT) is a decentralized reputation system where trust propagates through human relationships rather than central authorities. In Nostr, WoT is derived from follow lists (kind 3) and mute lists (kind 10000): users you follow are implicitly trusted, and their follows extend trust transitively. WoT enables user-controlled content moderation, spam filtering, and curation — each user sees a personalized view of the network weighted by the people they trust. In Tapestry, WoT (via GrapeRank) determines which concept definitions achieve 'loose consensus' across the community.
